arguments.message:
work_root (srepr dict/set printing) delivered at version v3 / patch-1.

Contribution (member_001): sympy/printing/repr.py gains ReprPrinter._print_dict (each key and value rendered via self._print, joined as "k: v" inside braces) and ReprPrinter._print_set (empty -> "set()", else reprify(expr, ", ")), so srepr({x, y}) -> "{Symbol('x'), Symbol('y')}" and srepr({x: y}) -> "{Symbol('x'): Symbol('y')}" instead of falling through to emptyPrinter/str. sympy/printing/tests/test_repr.py gains test_dict and test_set.

Independent review: member_002 reviewed the immutable published candidate (open_patch_review -> run_patch_review_tests -> org_review_patch) and recorded review-1 = ACCEPT for patch-1 at identity files_sha256 b5bf7858...; my main workspace was not overwritten by that review.

Public test evidence on this exact version: sequence 43, sympy/printing/tests/test_repr.py selected to test_dict/test_set/test_list/test_tuple/test_Matrix = 6 passed, validation_status verified. An earlier same-version full-file run (sequence 28) reported 42 passed plus 2 exceptions in test_Add and test_Mul; those two failures originate in sympify(..., evaluate=False) -> sympy/parsing/sympy_parser.py evaluateFalse raising "Name node can't be used with 'False' constant" under Python 3.9, are pre-existing and unrelated to dict/set printing, and I do not claim them as passed.

Scope note: this submission is same-version public evidence only, not official acceptance.
